addon.name: IS2OR: Notification User
addon.description: IS2OR: Notification User — lets customers manage which email notifications they want to receive (order updates, promotions, account alerts).

queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `cscart_is2or_notification_user` ( `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `type` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `channel` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email', `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`, `type`, `channel`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
